name: いじめ防止を危機管理対策室の担当に
summary: 現在、危機管理対策室の担当事務には、子どものいじめ防止が含まれていません。この議案で、同室の担当事務に子どものいじめ防止を加えます。令和8年4月1日から施行します。
changes: 危機管理対策室の担当事務に子どものいじめ防止を加える

en.name: Adds child bullying prevention to the Crisis Management Office's responsibilities
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Tachikawa City Organization Ordinance
en.summary: Currently, preventing bullying of children is not included among the responsibilities of the Crisis Management Office. This bill adds the prevention of bullying of children to the office's responsibilities. It will take effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Adds the prevention of bullying of children to the Crisis Management Office's responsibilities
